run_text_classification_training: run text classification training with autotrain using a specified model and dataset
register_text_classification_subcommand: register the text-classification subcommand parser with all training arguments for autotrain cli
create_text_classification_command: create a RunAutoTrainTextClassificationCommand instance from parsed argparse arguments
validate_text_classification_args: validate required arguments like project name, data path, and model for text classification
build_text_classification_project: build an AutoTrainProject for text classification using TextClassificationParams and a backend
